name: Mixed Lead Company
goal: Build a verified list of 50 real-estate developers and agencies in Prishtina (company, current project, phone, email, website) and draft outreach for owner approval.
approach: A strong external chief plans and synthesizes; a small local model does the bulk discovery; an external verifier checks websites and contact data; the owner approves drafts before anything is sent. Template for mixing runtimes — swap adapters to what you have installed (see docs/AGENT-CONTRACT.md).

agents.name: Chief
responsibilities: Split the goal into discovery, verification and outreach drafts
Synthesize subtask results into data/report.md with counts and gaps

agents.name: LeadScout
responsibilities: Find developers and agencies via search and public listings
Store rows in data/main.db table leads (name, project, city, phone, email, website, source)

agents.name: Verifier
responsibilities: Open each lead's website, confirm the company builds or sells in Kosovo, fix or flag contact data
Mark rows verified=1 or note why not in data/main.db

agents.name: Owner
responsibilities: Review outreach drafts in data/outreach/ and approve or request changes

rootTasks.title: 50 verified developer and agency leads in Prishtina
rootTasks.description: Plan the work across LeadScout (discovery), Verifier (checks) and Owner (approves outreach drafts). Deliver data/main.db table leads with verified rows and data/report.md. Nothing is sent to anyone — drafts only.
